commands: rm -rf protocols && cp -r ../protocols protocols && python3 -m build --wheel --outdir dist/ && rm -rf protocols
: ${PYPI_USERNAME:?PYPI_USERNAME must be set — see infrastructure/clusters/office/secrets/.env.example (PYPI_HTPASSWD username, always 'concord') or your team's secret store}
: ${PYPI_PASSWORD:?PYPI_PASSWORD must be set — plaintext for PYPI_HTPASSWD; source from your team's secret store}

kubectl port-forward -n staging svc/concord-pypi 18080:8080 >/dev/null 2>&1 & PF=$!; sleep 2; twine upload --repository-url http://localhost:18080 --username "$PYPI_USERNAME" --password "$PYPI_PASSWORD" --disable-progress-bar dist/*.whl; rc=$?; kill $PF 2>/dev/null || true; wait $PF 2>/dev/null || true; exit $rc
: ${PYPI_USERNAME:?PYPI_USERNAME must be set — see infrastructure/clusters/office/secrets/.env.example (PYPI_HTPASSWD username, always 'concord') or your team's secret store}
: ${PYPI_PASSWORD:?PYPI_PASSWORD must be set — plaintext for PYPI_HTPASSWD; source from your team's secret store}

kubectl port-forward -n production svc/concord-pypi 18081:8080 >/dev/null 2>&1 & PF=$!; sleep 2; twine upload --repository-url http://localhost:18081 --username "$PYPI_USERNAME" --password "$PYPI_PASSWORD" --disable-progress-bar dist/*.whl; rc=$?; kill $PF 2>/dev/null || true; wait $PF 2>/dev/null || true; exit $rc
